data.description:
## Incident Overview

**Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (CLI_user)
**code_version:** 1f0032df245a260e8b8d445128d04a739af9e49d

### Expected
Direct push to orphan `tickets` branch from ticket-lib.sh (`_push_tickets_branch`) reaches origin. The branch is an append-only event log; the CLI is the sole writer.

### Actual
Push rejected with GH013: required status check "review-sub-pr" not satisfied. Local commit lands; origin/tickets diverges.

Concrete reproducer (this session, 2026-05-29):
- Local tickets HEAD: `918854be38 ticket: COMMENT a06c-7075-6c1e-4a96`
- origin/tickets HEAD: `9c7e6c171b suggestion: RECORD` (no a06c comment present)

### Root cause
GitHub ruleset 16961402 "DSO Sub-PR Review Enforcement" (ENFORCEMENT=active, TARGET=branch, INCLUDE=`~ALL`, EXCLUDE=`refs/heads/main` only).
- Bypass: RepositoryRole:5 (Admin) in `pull_request` mode only — NOT push mode
- Effect: every non-main branch (including the orphan `tickets` branch) requires the `review-sub-pr` check, which never runs on direct ticket-lib pushes

Verified via `gh api repos/.../rules/branches/tickets` and `.../rulesets/16961402`.

### Action history
- ticket-lib.sh `_push_tickets_branch` already hardened for merge/dirty-WD contention (12a6); returns 0 best-effort with terminal warning "tickets branch push failed after 3 retries". That hardening is correct for transient contention but cannot recover from a hard-reject (GH013).
- Reconciler / bridge writes that DO reach origin/tickets appear to come from PR-merged paths (e.g. `suggestion: RECORD` commits), not direct CLI pushes.

### Proposed fix (REQUIRES USER + ADMIN APPROVAL — modifies repo safeguard)
Add `refs/heads/tickets` to ruleset 16961402's EXCLUDE list (alongside `refs/heads/main`). One-line config change; restores direct-push capability for the orphan event log without weakening sub-PR review on any feature branch.

Alternative: add an actor bypass for the ticket-CLI bot identity in push mode — narrower but requires identifying / provisioning a bot identity.

### Files / surfaces
- GitHub ruleset 16961402 (repo config, no code change)
- plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh `_push_tickets_branch` (no change; existing best-effort warning is the user-visible symptom)
data.title: [gh-ruleset/tickets-branch]: required-check rule blocks direct push -> all session ticket writes fail to reach origin
